brief.claim: In patients with heart failure, a larger right ventricular end-diastolic volume goes with a lower right ventricular ejection fraction: across 30 patients, the standardised slope (both variables z-scored) of end-diastolic volume index on ejection fraction is at most -0.4.

data_keys.meaning: stroke volume index, mL/m2, from thermodilution
right ventricular ejection fraction, fraction 0-1, from a fast-response thermistor catheter
right ventricular end-diastolic volume index, mL/m2, from gated radionuclide ventriculography done in the same session
